about: Per-throw reference events from public Kubb video, measured frame by frame. Times are seconds into the source video. Lengths in kubb lengths (15 cm) where the camera gives no better scale. See REALCLIPS.md.

events.uncertainty: run on +-1 kubb length (foreshortened); bounce count +-1 (30 fps, small image)
events.rest: lying (toppled from the end it landed on)
events.spin: end over end in the air
